mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing starts (HOUST < 1500) combined with elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.2%) signal a deteriorating consumer demand environment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) indicates persistent price pressures that prompt aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL > 320 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150000) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS > 150000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1500) reflect weak residential construction activity and declining consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and retail sales (RSAFS < 700000) indicates a contraction in both supply and demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
